name: caliber-analysis
description: Analyzes how your team uses Claude Code. Captures session activity — prompts, responses, and tool use — with secrets redacted on your machine before anything is sent, then ships it to your Caliber tenant for AI-governance insights. Bearer-authenticated, idempotent, and non-blocking. MDM installs may omit email until Claude login; identity resolves from Claude oauthAccount, CALIBER_EMAIL, or git.
